retrievalProfile.description: A close-up studio portrait featuring a male subject in a herringbone blazer leaning on a fedora against a mottled warm-toned background with elegant serif typography in the upper right.
triggerTerms: man in herringbone jacket leaning on hat

minimalist flat vector illustration is needed
outdoor natural light photography is specified

recipe.visualDefinition: A tight, intimate head-and-shoulders portrait of a man with a well-groomed beard and mustache. He wears a heavy-textured grey and black herringbone blazer over a white pinstriped shirt. His right hand rests on the brim of a brown felt fedora, which occupies the lower-left foreground. The lighting is soft and directional, creating gentle shadows that define facial structure. The background is a warm, painterly mottled surface in shades of tan and ochre, showing a visible offset-print grain texture.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject's direct gaze creates intimate connection
Hand and hat provide a diagonal anchor in the lower left
Textured blazer contrasts with the smooth skin tones
Typography is tucked into the negative space of the upper right corner
coreInvariants: Direct eye contact with the viewer

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Centered head-and-shoulders crop, filling approximately 70% of the vertical frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's eyes and the hand resting on the hat brim.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the eyes, moves down to the hand and hat, then sweeps up to the typography in the top right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Limited to the upper right and left corners around the head.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm tan and ochre (background and skin tones)
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Black and white (herringbone pattern and shirt)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Muted saturation with high value contrast in the clothing textures.

characterSpecificRedesigns: Italicized secondary line for stylistic contrast
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Roman serif for the primary name paired with an italic version of the same family for the title.

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the tight tracking and high-contrast 80s serif look.
Matches the classic, formal feel of the secondary text line.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a studio portrait of a man with a beard in a grey herringbone blazer, leaning his hand on a brown fedora against a mottled tan background with visible print grain.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add two lines of right-aligned serif text in the upper right corner using a high-contrast font like Garamond; the second line should be italicized.

verificationChecks: Is the herringbone pattern clearly visible?
Is the text right-aligned in the upper right corner?
Does the background have a warm, mottled texture?
Is the subject looking directly at the camera?

adjustableVariables: Position of the hand on the hat brim
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the original artist

mustAchieve: Soft studio lighting with warm shadows

postGenerationChecks: Verify the herringbone pattern is not distorted
Ensure the typography does not overlap the subject's head
Check that the color palette remains in the warm/earthy range
recipe.reuseFormula: Studio Portrait + Herringbone Texture + Mottled Tan Backdrop + Right-Aligned Serif Typography = 80s Soul Aesthetic
